```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE)

required_packages <- c("shiny", "bslib", "ggplot2", "caret", "class", "titanic", "plotly", "DT", "scales")
new_packages <- required_packages[!(required_packages %in% installed.packages()[, "Package"])]
if (length(new_packages)) install.packages(new_packages)

library(shiny)
library(bslib)
library(ggplot2)
library(caret)
library(class)
library(titanic)
library(plotly)
library(DT)
library(scales)

set.seed(123)
data("titanic_train")

raw_data <- titanic_train[, c("Survived", "Pclass", "Sex", "Age", "Fare")]

cleaned_data <- na.omit(raw_data)

titanic <- cleaned_data
titanic$Survived <- factor(titanic$Survived, levels = c(0, 1), labels = c("Died", "Survived"))
titanic$Sex <- factor(titanic$Sex)

train_index <- createDataPartition(titanic$Survived, p = 0.7, list = FALSE)
train_data <- titanic[train_index, ]
test_data <- titanic[-train_index, ]

num_cols <- c("Pclass", "Age", "Fare")
pre_proc <- preProcess(train_data[, num_cols], method = c("center", "scale"))

build_features <- function(df, scaled = TRUE) {
  feature_df <- df[, c("Pclass", "Sex", "Age", "Fare")]
  if (scaled) {
    feature_df[, num_cols] <- predict(pre_proc, feature_df[, num_cols])
  }
  feature_df$Sex <- as.numeric(feature_df$Sex)
  feature_df
}

train_x_scaled <- build_features(train_data, scaled = TRUE)
test_x_scaled <- build_features(test_data, scaled = TRUE)
train_x_unscaled <- build_features(train_data, scaled = FALSE)
test_x_unscaled <- build_features(test_data, scaled = FALSE)

evaluate_knn <- function(k, mode) {
  train_x <- if (mode == "scaled") train_x_scaled else train_x_unscaled
  test_x <- if (mode == "scaled") test_x_scaled else test_x_unscaled

  pred <- knn(train = train_x, test = test_x, cl = train_data$Survived, k = k)
  cm <- confusionMatrix(pred, test_data$Survived)

  list(
    accuracy = as.numeric(cm$overall["Accuracy"]),
    sensitivity = as.numeric(cm$byClass["Sensitivity"]),
    specificity = as.numeric(cm$byClass["Specificity"]),
    cm_table = as.data.frame.matrix(cm$table),
    truth_pred = data.frame(
      Actual = test_data$Survived,
      Predicted = pred,
      Match = ifelse(pred == test_data$Survived, "Correct", "Incorrect")
    )
  )
}

k_values <- seq(1, 35, by = 2)
scaled_acc <- sapply(k_values, function(k) evaluate_knn(k, "scaled")$accuracy)
unscaled_acc <- sapply(k_values, function(k) evaluate_knn(k, "unscaled")$accuracy)

accuracy_curve <- rbind(
  data.frame(k = k_values, accuracy = scaled_acc, mode = "Scaled"),
  data.frame(k = k_values, accuracy = unscaled_acc, mode = "Unscaled")
)

feature_range <- data.frame(
  Feature = num_cols,
  Raw = sapply(train_data[, num_cols], function(x) diff(range(x))),
  Scaled = sapply(train_x_scaled[, num_cols], function(x) diff(range(x)))
)

partition_summary <- data.frame(
  Split = c("Train", "Test", "Total (Cleaned)"),
  Rows = c(nrow(train_data), nrow(test_data), nrow(cleaned_data)),
  Percent = c(
    100 * nrow(train_data) / nrow(cleaned_data),
    100 * nrow(test_data) / nrow(cleaned_data),
    100
  )
)

scaled_display <- cleaned_data
scaled_display[, num_cols] <- predict(pre_proc, cleaned_data[, num_cols])

unscaled_display <- cleaned_data
```

```{r server, include=FALSE}
model_result <- reactive({
  evaluate_knn(input$k_val, input$scale_mode)
})

single_prediction <- reactive({
  req(input$pred_pclass, input$pred_sex, input$pred_age, input$pred_fare, input$k_val, input$scale_mode)

  train_x <- if (input$scale_mode == "scaled") train_x_scaled else train_x_unscaled

  new_obs <- data.frame(
    Pclass = input$pred_pclass,
    Sex = factor(input$pred_sex, levels = levels(titanic$Sex)),
    Age = input$pred_age,
    Fare = input$pred_fare
  )

  if (input$scale_mode == "scaled") {
    new_obs[, num_cols] <- predict(pre_proc, new_obs[, num_cols])
  }

  new_obs$Sex <- as.numeric(new_obs$Sex)

  dists <- sqrt(rowSums((sweep(train_x, 2, as.numeric(new_obs[1, ]), "-"))^2))
  neighbor_idx <- order(dists)[seq_len(min(input$k_val, length(dists)))]

  neighbor_df <- train_data[neighbor_idx, c("Survived", "Pclass", "Sex", "Age", "Fare")]
  neighbor_df$Distance <- round(dists[neighbor_idx], 4)

  pred <- knn(train = train_x, test = new_obs, cl = train_data$Survived, k = input$k_val)
  votes <- table(neighbor_df$Survived)

  list(
    predicted = as.character(pred[1]),
    votes = votes,
    neighbors = neighbor_df
  )
})

output$metric_cards <- renderUI({
  res <- model_result()

  card <- function(label, value) {
    div(
      class = "kpi-card",
      tags$p(class = "kpi-label", label),
      tags$p(class = "kpi-value", value)
    )
  }

  div(
    class = "kpi-grid",
    card("Accuracy", sprintf("%.1f%%", 100 * res$accuracy)),
    card("Sensitivity", sprintf("%.1f%%", 100 * res$sensitivity)),
    card("Specificity", sprintf("%.1f%%", 100 * res$specificity)),
    card("k Value", as.character(input$k_val))
  )
})

output$cm_table <- renderDT({
  datatable(
    model_result()$cm_table,
    options = list(dom = "t", ordering = FALSE, pageLength = 5),
    rownames = TRUE
  )
})

output$cm_breakdown <- renderUI({
  cm <- model_result()$cm_table

  tp <- if (all(c("Survived", "Survived") %in% c(rownames(cm), colnames(cm)))) cm["Survived", "Survived"] else 0
  tn <- if (all(c("Died", "Died") %in% c(rownames(cm), colnames(cm)))) cm["Died", "Died"] else 0
  fp <- if (all(c("Died", "Survived") %in% c(rownames(cm), colnames(cm)))) cm["Died", "Survived"] else 0
  fn <- if (all(c("Survived", "Died") %in% c(rownames(cm), colnames(cm)))) cm["Survived", "Died"] else 0

  pill <- function(label, value) {
    div(
      class = "cm-pill",
      tags$p(class = "cm-pill-title", label),
      tags$p(class = "cm-pill-value", as.character(value))
    )
  }

  div(
    class = "cm-grid",
    pill("True Positive", tp),
    pill("False Positive", fp),
    pill("True Negative", tn),
    pill("False Negative", fn)
  )
})

output$k_curve <- renderPlotly({
  p <- ggplot(accuracy_curve, aes(x = k, y = accuracy, color = mode, text = paste("k:", k, "<br>Accuracy:", percent(accuracy, accuracy = 0.1)))) +
    geom_line(linewidth = 1.2) +
    geom_point(size = 2) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = input$k_val, linetype = "dashed", color = "#102a43") +
    scale_color_manual(values = c("Scaled" = "#0f766e", "Unscaled" = "#c2410c")) +
    scale_y_continuous(labels = percent_format(accuracy = 1), limits = c(0.65, 0.9)) +
    labs(x = "k", y = "Accuracy", color = "Mode") +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 13) +
    theme(
      plot.background = element_rect(fill = "transparent", color = NA),
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
      legend.position = "top"
    )

  ggplotly(p, tooltip = "text") %>% layout(margin = list(l = 40, r = 10, t = 15, b = 40))
})

output$range_plot <- renderPlotly({
  df <- data.frame(
    Feature = rep(feature_range$Feature, 2),
    Range = c(feature_range$Raw, feature_range$Scaled),
    Mode = rep(c("Raw", "Scaled"), each = nrow(feature_range))
  )

  p <- ggplot(df, aes(x = Feature, y = Range, fill = Mode, text = paste("Feature:", Feature, "<br>Range:", round(Range, 2)))) +
    geom_col(position = "dodge") +
    scale_fill_manual(values = c("Raw" = "#c2410c", "Scaled" = "#0f766e")) +
    labs(x = NULL, y = "Range width", fill = NULL) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 13) +
    theme(
      plot.background = element_rect(fill = "transparent", color = NA),
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
      legend.position = "top"
    )

  ggplotly(p, tooltip = "text") %>% layout(margin = list(l = 45, r = 10, t = 15, b = 40))
})

output$actual_pred_plot <- renderPlotly({
  df <- model_result()$truth_pred
  counts <- as.data.frame(table(df$Actual, df$Predicted))
  names(counts) <- c("Actual", "Predicted", "Count")
  counts$Type <- ifelse(counts$Actual == counts$Predicted, "Correct", "Incorrect")

  p <- ggplot(
    counts,
    aes(
      x = Actual,
      y = Predicted,
      fill = Count,
      text = paste("Actual:", Actual, "<br>Predicted:", Predicted, "<br>Count:", Count, "<br>", Type)
    )
  ) +
    geom_tile(color = "white", linewidth = 1) +
    geom_text(aes(label = Count), color = "#111827", fontface = "bold", size = 5) +
    scale_fill_gradient(low = "#d1fae5", high = "#047857") +
    labs(x = "Actual Class", y = "Predicted Class", fill = "Count") +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
    theme(
      panel.grid = element_blank(),
      legend.position = "none",
      plot.background = element_rect(fill = "transparent", color = NA)
    )

  ggplotly(p, tooltip = "text") %>% layout(margin = list(l = 40, r = 10, t = 10, b = 40))
})

output$single_pred_summary <- renderUI({
  res <- single_prediction()
  survived_votes <- if ("Survived" %in% names(res$votes)) as.integer(res$votes[["Survived"]]) else 0
  died_votes <- if ("Died" %in% names(res$votes)) as.integer(res$votes[["Died"]]) else 0

  div(
    class = "predict-result",
    tags$p(class = "predict-main", paste("Predicted Class:", res$predicted)),
    tags$p(class = "predict-sub", paste0("Neighbor votes (k = ", input$k_val, ") -> Survived: ", survived_votes, " | Died: ", died_votes))
  )
})

output$neighbor_table <- renderDT({
  datatable(
    single_prediction()$neighbors,
    options = list(pageLength = 6, scrollX = TRUE, order = list(list(5, "asc"))),
    rownames = FALSE
  )
})

output$neighbor_scatter <- renderPlotly({
  req(input$pred_age, input$pred_fare)

  train_plot <- train_data[, c("Age", "Fare", "Survived")]
  train_plot$Group <- "Training"

  train_x <- if (input$scale_mode == "scaled") train_x_scaled else train_x_unscaled
  new_obs <- data.frame(
    Pclass = input$pred_pclass,
    Sex = factor(input$pred_sex, levels = levels(titanic$Sex)),
    Age = input$pred_age,
    Fare = input$pred_fare
  )
  if (input$scale_mode == "scaled") {
    new_obs[, num_cols] <- predict(pre_proc, new_obs[, num_cols])
  }
  new_obs$Sex <- as.numeric(new_obs$Sex)

  dists <- sqrt(rowSums((sweep(train_x, 2, as.numeric(new_obs[1, ]), "-"))^2))
  neighbor_idx <- order(dists)[seq_len(min(input$k_val, length(dists)))]

  neighbors_plot <- train_data[neighbor_idx, c("Age", "Fare", "Survived")]
  neighbors_plot$Group <- "Nearest Neighbor"

  input_plot <- data.frame(
    Age = input$pred_age,
    Fare = input$pred_fare,
    Survived = "Input",
    Group = "Input Point"
  )

  combined <- rbind(
    data.frame(train_plot, stringsAsFactors = FALSE),
    data.frame(neighbors_plot, stringsAsFactors = FALSE),
    input_plot
  )

  p <- ggplot(combined, aes(x = Age, y = Fare, text = paste("Age:", round(Age, 1), "<br>Fare:", round(Fare, 2), "<br>Class:", Survived, "<br>Type:", Group))) +
    geom_point(
      data = subset(combined, Group == "Training"),
      color = "#9ca3af",
      alpha = 0.35,
      size = 2
    ) +
    geom_point(
      data = subset(combined, Group == "Nearest Neighbor"),
      aes(color = as.factor(Survived)),
      size = 3,
      alpha = 0.95
    ) +
    geom_point(
      data = subset(combined, Group == "Input Point"),
      color = "#ef4444",
      size = 4,
      shape = 8,
      stroke = 1.2
    ) +
    scale_color_manual(values = c("Died" = "#1f2937", "Survived" = "#0f766e"), drop = FALSE) +
    labs(x = "Age", y = "Fare", color = "Neighbor Class") +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
    theme(
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
      plot.background = element_rect(fill = "transparent", color = NA)
    )

  ggplotly(p, tooltip = "text") %>% layout(margin = list(l = 45, r = 10, t = 10, b = 40))
})

output$data_table_raw_clean <- renderDT({
  df <- if (input$raw_clean_view == "raw") {
    raw_data
  } else {
    cleaned_data
  }

  datatable(
    df,

})

output$partition_table <- renderDT({

  )
})

output$partition_plot <- renderPlotly({
  df <- partition_summary[partition_summary$Split %in% c("Train", "Test"), ]

  p <- ggplot(df, aes(x = Split, y = Rows, fill = Split, text = paste0(Split, "<br>Rows: ", Rows, "<br>", sprintf("%.1f%%", Percent)))) +
    geom_col(width = 0.6) +
    geom_text(aes(label = paste0(sprintf("%.1f", Percent), "%")), vjust = -0.5, fontface = "bold") +
    scale_fill_manual(values = c("Train" = "#0f766e", "Test" = "#c2410c")) +
    labs(x = NULL, y = "Rows") +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
    theme(
      legend.position = "none",
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
      plot.background = element_rect(fill = "transparent", color = NA)
    )

  ggplotly(p, tooltip = "text") %>% layout(margin = list(l = 45, r = 10, t = 10, b = 35))
})
```
